name: SmoothUI
summary: Free MIT animated React components on Motion and GSAP for shadcn/ui.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 of ~200 registry:ui items — not a full inventory (blocks/templates not ingested).
Also installable via SmoothUI CLI (`npx smoothui-cli@latest add <name>`); catalog prefers official @smoothui shadcn namespace.
Some comps pull GSAP or WebGL peers beyond Motion — check per-item registry dependencies.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Dynamic Island
components.summary: iOS-style Dynamic Island that morphs between compact and expanded states.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @smoothui/dynamic-island

import DynamicIsland from "@/components/smoothui/dynamic-island"

<DynamicIsland />

copyPrompt.text: Use SmoothUI free MIT component `Dynamic Island` (slug `dynamic-island`) from https://smoothui.dev/docs/components/dynamic-island. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @smoothui/dynamic-island` (official shadcn registry namespace @smoothui) or `npx smoothui-cli@latest add dynamic-island`. Registry item: https://smoothui.dev/r/dynamic-island.json. Imports land under `@/components/smoothui/dynamic-island`. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind; Motion/GSAP peers as listed in registry. License: MIT (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/educlopez/smoothui/main/LICENSE). Pricing free — open source.
